criteria.reason: Bare 'Non' applies none of the four tests (source, precision, independent data, fact/opinion separation) set in turn 1.
Flat 'Non' is an unsupported verdict: no reasoning, no uncertainty, no admission that evidence is insufficient.
No facts separated from claims; assumptions (storage, imports, demand, timing) and Federal Council framing entirely absent.
Definitive rejection of one camp's claim, unlike the suspended judgement on the first, breaks even-handed neutral treatment.

summary: Bare 'Non' is an unsupported verdict ignoring the stated criteria, noting no assumptions, and rejecting one camp's claim more harshly than the first.
